baseline.policy: No cross-context fallback. Missing context returns a degradation reason.
baseline.claim_boundary: Reuses the frozen normal WALK baseline; no new baseline fitting on TEST media.

limitations: Existing 29 clips were already inspected and cannot become a new blind test set.
A single clip is one activity window; persistent trend alert requires two independent windows.
No missing immediate signal family is synthesized.
Furniture occlusion remains a limitation unless an observable proxy crosses the fixed gate.
